summary: Join our derivatives and risk hedging strategies training course to gain essential skills for managing financial risks and optimizing your investment portfolio.
lede: Derivatives hedging helps finance, treasury, and risk professionals assess market exposures and choose contracts to manage them. This course develops skills in mapping exposures, calculating hedge ratios, pricing futures, forwards, options, and swaps, and testing hedge effectiveness, so professionals can document and explain risk decisions to finance leaders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to evaluate exposure, structure hedges, and explain derivative decisions with evidence.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of corporate finance, financial markets, and basic spreadsheet analysis. Familiarity with present value, discounting, and simple probability concepts will help, but no programming is required. If you currently review FX, commodity, interest rate, or equity exposures, you will be able to follow the course more effectively because the exercises rely on practical exposure data, hedge calculations, and policy-based decision making.
